title: Waivers a human recorded for one run
description: Human-authored, not a stage output, and the only such file that lives at the run root beside manifest.json and decisions.md. It records that a check-refs finding is correct and its remedy is not available in the stage the finding names: the finding keeps printing, prefixed [waived], and only its contribution to the exit code goes away. Written by `rubrica waive` rather than by hand, so that id, recorded_at and the remedy choices are minted rather than typed. Because a person wrote this file, a schema failure here is a usage error (exit 2) rather than a finding -- there is no stage to send a repair prompt to, which is the same reason it carries no entry in validate.STAGE_ARTIFACTS.
